description: Call when a business has a server that is not listed and wants agents to find it. Returns a status page and an optional owner token. Observation takes days; listing is not guaranteed. Example: {"url":"example.com","category":"booking"}

about.description: One sentence: what the business does and for whom

category.description: What the business does; agents also see the category its tools show

charges.description: Whether the server charges agents (x402 or a subscription)

language.description: Main language of the tools and their data

url.description: The MCP server address, or the business domain (example.com)
